data.name: AppTagline
data.value: Sort your photos by the day they were taken.

data.name: AboutBody
data.value: Snapdate gives your photos clear names based on the day they were taken. Everything runs on your computer: no account, no tracking, and your photos never leave it.

data.name: PickTargetTitle
data.value: Where should the renamed photos be saved?

data.name: DropHint

data.name: PatternHint

data.name: ExtensionNote
data.value: The file type (.jpg, .png, .heic …) is kept automatically.

data.name: AboutPrivacy
data.value: Only checks GitHub for new versions — and only if you allow it.

data.name: UpdateNoticeText
data.value: Snapdate checks GitHub once a day for new versions. You can turn this off in About.

data.name: UpdateCheckFailed
data.value: Couldn't check right now — are you offline?

data.name: UpdateInstalling
data.value: Installing the update. Windows may ask for permission. Snapdate restarts by itself afterwards.

data.name: UpdateFailedDownload
data.value: The download failed. Check your internet connection and try again, or get the new version from the download page.

data.name: UpdateFailedVerify
data.value: The download could not be verified, so it was not installed. Please get the new version from the download page.

data.name: UpdateFailedMissing
data.value: This release has no installer for your PC. Please get the new version from the download page.

data.name: UpdateFailedStart
data.value: The installer could not be started. Please get the new version from the download page.

data.name: UpdateFailedInstaller
data.value: The installation was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

data.name: RulesLinkTip
data.value: See and switch the rules Snapdate uses to read dates from file names, and try a file name.

data.name: RulesIntro
data.value: When a photo has no camera date, Snapdate reads the date from the file name with the first rule that fits (your own rules first). Note: the date in a name is often the day the picture was received, not taken.

data.name: RulesSourceSystemTip
data.value: Comes with Snapdate. You can switch it off or duplicate it to make your own version.

data.name: RulesSourceCustomTip
data.value: Your own rule. It is tried before the built-in rules and never changed by updates.

data.name: RuleSyntaxUnsupported
data.value: This rule is written as "{0}", which this version of Snapdate cannot use yet. It is kept but not used.

data.name: RulesUnreadable
data.value: Your own rules could not be read. Built-in rules still work. Saving will keep a copy of the old file.

data.name: RulesNewerVersion
data.value: Your rules were saved by a newer version of Snapdate. You can look at them here but not change them.

data.name: RulesInaccessible
data.value: Your rules file could not be opened, so the rules cannot be changed right now. Please try again later.

data.name: RulesConflict
data.value: Your rules were changed elsewhere (for example in another Snapdate window). The list was reloaded; please make your change again.

data.name: RulesSaveFailed
data.value: Your change could not be saved, so it was undone. Please try again later.

data.name: RulesTooLarge
data.value: Your change could not be saved because the rules would be too large. It was undone.

data.name: RulesReadOnly
data.value: Your rules cannot be changed right now.

data.name: RulesFull
data.value: You already have the maximum of {0} own rules. Delete one first.

data.value: Pick a file from the folder

data.value: File names from the chosen folder

data.name: TesterCreateRule
data.value: Create a rule from this name

data.name: TesterCreateRuleTip
data.value: Opens a new rule with a pattern for names like this one. You can change it before saving.

data.name: RuleEditorIntro
data.value: Describe how your file names look. Snapdate tries the patterns from top to bottom and reads the date with the first one that fits the whole name (without the extension).

data.name: RulePatternsHint
data.value: Click a block to insert it at the cursor. * stands for any text, ? for exactly one character. Everything else must be in the name exactly like this; upper and lower case do not matter.

data.name: RuleNoPatterns
data.value: Type at least one pattern, for example IMG-{{YYYY}}{{MM}}{{DD}}-WA*

data.name: RuleTooManyPatterns
data.value: A rule can have at most {0} patterns. Please remove {1} line(s).

data.name: RuleNameTooLong
data.value: The name can be at most {0} characters long.

data.name: PatErrTooLong
data.value: This pattern is too long (at most {0} characters).

data.name: PatErrUnclosedBrace
data.value: There is a “{{” without a closing “}}”.

data.name: PatErrClosingBrace
data.value: There is a “}}” without an opening “{{”. To use a brace as text, type it twice: }}}}

data.name: PatErrUnknownToken
data.value: “{{{0}}}” is not a block Snapdate knows. Use the blocks below, such as {{YYYY}}.

data.name: PatErrUnsupportedToken
data.value: “{{{0}}}” cannot be read from a file name. Use number blocks such as {{MM}} for the month.

data.name: PatErrDuplicateToken
data.value: “{{{0}}}” repeats a part of the date that is already in the pattern. Each part may appear only once.

data.name: PatErrMissingYear
data.value: The pattern needs a year: {{YYYY}} or {{YY}}.

data.name: PatErrMissingMonth
data.value: The pattern needs a month: {{MM}} or {{M}}.

data.name: PatErrMissingDay
data.value: The pattern needs a day: {{DD}} or {{D}}.

data.name: PatErrHourWithoutMinute
data.value: An hour also needs minutes: add {{mm}}.

data.name: PatErrMinuteWithoutHour
data.value: Minutes also need an hour: add {{HH}}.

data.name: PatErrAmbiguous
data.value: The digits around “{{{0}}}” could be read in more than one way. Put a separator such as - or _ between the parts, or use two-digit blocks like {{MM}} and {{DD}}. Also, * must not touch these digits, and ? must not be used anywhere among them.

data.name: PatErrInvalid
data.value: This pattern cannot be used. Please check it.

data.name: RuleSampleEmpty
data.value: Type a file name to try your patterns.

data.name: RuleSampleNoPatterns
data.value: Type a valid pattern first, then try a file name.

data.name: RuleSampleInvalid
data.value: Line {0} matches, but {1} is not a valid date.

data.name: RuleSampleImplausible
data.value: Line {0} matches, but {1} is before 1900 or in the future.

data.name: RuleRegexToggleTip
data.value: For users who know regular expressions. Your text is kept when you switch.

data.name: RuleRegexLabel
data.value: Regular expressions (one per line, up to {0})

data.name: RuleRegexHint
data.value: Mark the date parts with named groups: year (or yy for two digits), month and day; hour, minute and second are optional. The expression must fit the whole name (without the extension); upper and lower case do not matter. Example:

data.name: RuleRegexNoPatterns
data.value: Type at least one regular expression, for example {0}

data.name: RuleRegexOk
data.value: All regular expressions can be used.

data.name: RuleRegexSampleNoPatterns
data.value: Type a valid regular expression first, then try a file name.

data.name: RuleRegexSampleNoMatch
data.value: No regular expression matches this name.

data.name: RxErrTooLong
data.value: This expression is too long (at most {0} characters).

data.name: RxErrInvalid
data.value: This expression cannot be used. Please check it.

data.name: RxErrSyntax
data.value: This is not a valid regular expression. Check the brackets and special characters around character {0}.

data.name: RxErrUnsupported
data.value: “{0}” (at character {1}) cannot be used. Snapdate allows plain characters, escaped characters such as \. or \(, \d, \s, \w, ., simple classes such as [a-z_-], groups (…), (?:…) and (?<name>…), | between alternatives, ^ and $, and the repetitions * + ? {{n}} {{n,}} {{n,m}}. Write \{{, \}} and \] for the characters themselves.

data.name: RxErrRepetition
data.value: The repetition {0} is too large. At most {1} repetitions are possible.

data.name: RxErrUnknownGroup
data.value: The group “{0}” is not a date part. Use year, yy, month, day, hour, minute or second, in lower case.

data.name: RxErrMissingYear
data.value: The expression needs a group for the year: (?<year>…) or (?<yy>…).

data.name: RxErrMissingMonth
data.value: The expression needs a group for the month: (?<month>…).

data.name: RxErrMissingDay
data.value: The expression needs a group for the day: (?<day>…).

data.name: RxErrHourWithoutMinute
data.value: An hour group also needs a minute group: add (?<minute>…).

data.name: RxErrMinuteWithoutHour
data.value: A minute group also needs an hour group: add (?<hour>…).

data.name: RxErrSecondWithoutMinute
data.value: A second group also needs a minute group: add (?<minute>…).

data.name: RuleRegexEditorIntro
data.value: Describe how your file names look. Snapdate tries the expressions from top to bottom and reads the date with the first one that fits the whole name (without the extension).

data.name: RxErrNested
data.value: The repetition {0} repeats something whose length can vary, such as *, +, ? or alternatives of different length like (?:a|bc). Snapdate does not allow this because it can make matching very slow. Write the parts out one after another instead.

data.name: RxErrTooComplex
data.value: This expression is too complex to run quickly. Use fewer * and +, fewer repetitions overall and smaller counts in {{…}}, or shorten it.

data.name: TipRulesHint
data.value: The rules are under "Dates from file names" above the list.
